4 ways Kiro runs work in parallel (agent focus, sub-agents, task waves, cloud sessions)

Four ways Kiro does work in parallel.

1. Agent focus - Parallel sessions. Experimental.
2. Sub-agents - Helper agents run side by side.
3. Task waves - Spec tasks run in dependency waves.
4. Cloud sessions - Up to ten run at once, even offline.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/custom-agents/subagents/
